text: A single girl with aqua hair in twintails and aqua eyes, an ahoge sticking up. She wears a strapless white dress with frills and short sleeves, a flower and leaf tucked in, an umbrella beside her, bare-shouldered.
A comic of two girls indoors, one with white hair, small horns and a tail, the other black-haired in glasses. They wear white collared shirts with black gloves, red eyes bright.
A single virtual-youtuber girl with long black hair, animal ears and yellow eyes grins widely. She wears a white shirt with a bowtie in an official alternate costume, looking at the viewer.
黒髪のショートヘアに獣耳と角を持つ女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。褐色肌に茶色の瞳、黒いシャツにパンツ、裸足。舌をのぞかせた豊かな体つきで描いてください。
A single girl with long brown hair in two side-up tails and brown eyes, her hair floating. She wears a blue dress with frills and a bowtie under a jacket, an ornament in her hair, long lashes.
茶色のミディアムヘアの男の子を、複数の角度から。褐色肌に茶色の瞳、ひげをたくわえ、鎧と兜、肘までの指なし手袋、サンダル。凛々しい姿で描いてください。

A comic of a single girl in a school sailor uniform indoors, shown in multiple views. She wears a sailor collar with a neckerchief and a long skirt, a box and couch nearby — a genderswapped take, English text in the panels.
とても長い髪をツインテールにした女の子を一人で。肩を出した装いに長袖、プリーツスカートとブーツ、ネクタイ。歯を見せて笑った華奢な姿で描いてください。
A single boy with very long hair in pink and purple in a ponytail looks at the viewer, holding a weapon. He wears a jacket worn open with pants and boots, an ornament in his hair.
A chibi girl with long black hair and grey eyes wears a blue dress with pantyhose, a flower and ornament in her hair, earrings glinting. A small mole on her — an official alternate costume.
A chibi elf girl with long white hair in twintails and green eyes, pointed ears and thick brows. She wears a white skirt with a capelet, her pupils bright, earrings glinting.
A single girl shown as a silhouette in full body against a white background, English text the focus of the piece.
長い髪を三つ編みにした女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。片目を前髪で隠し、白いシャツの半袖にスカートとエプロン、フリル、帽子。靴下と靴を合わせた姿で描いてください。
A single boy in a blue short-sleeved shirt with shorts and sandals, a Pokémon beside him. A cup, leaves and a plant around them, framed by a white border; a twitter handle in the corner.
オレンジから別の色へのグラデーションの、とても長い髪の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。アクアブルーの瞳に、コートに黒い手袋とベルト、パンツ、帽子。凛々しい姿で描いてください。
金、青、灰の混ざったとても長い髪の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。しっぽを持ち、肩を出したジャケットの長袖。鎖骨をのぞかせ、装飾品を着けた姿で描いてください。
No humans — a shiny, alternate-colour Pokémon shown in full body against a grey background, drawn in flat colour, the animal the focus; the artist signed it.
A single girl with long black and grey hair, animal ears poking up. She wears a black jacket with a black skirt and gloves, a clip in her hair, bangs between her eyes.
A single girl with short black hair and green eyes wears a white short-sleeved shirt with a skirt and a hat with a bow and ribbon. Earrings and shoes, food beside her.
A single toned boy with brown hair and brown eyes adjusts his white tank top, stretching, seen from the side against a white background. A mole under one eye, sportswear on him.
女の子と男の子を、ともにエルフとして。白い髪に尖った耳、三つ編みと髪リボン、X字の髪飾り。薔薇と白い花のなか、紫の瞳で寄り添う姿で描いてください。
金髪の長い髪に狐の耳を持つ女の子を一人で。ピンクの瞳に、手の先まで余る袖、髪に白い花飾り、頭上に光輪。ふさふさの耳をのぞかせた姿で描いてください。
A single girl with short black hair and green eyes wears a white collared shirt with shorts under a black coat with gold trim, a hat on her head. A red neckerchief at her collar.
黒髪のショートヘアの女の子を一人で。黄色い瞳に三つ編み、白いシャツに前を開けたジャケットとネクタイ、パンスト、靴。髪飾りを着けた別衣装姿で描いてください。
A single boy with short hair in brown and black, eyes red and green in heterochromia, looks at the viewer holding a sword. He wears a headband, bangs framing his face.
黒髪の男の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。左右で青と黄色に分かれた瞳に、フードをかぶり、袖なしの装い。武器を手に、瞳を光らせた姿で、署名を添えて描いてください。
二人の女の子を、こちらを見つめさせてください。青髪のとても長い髪にアホ毛、白いシャツにジャケットとネクタイ、サイドの髪。ピンクの瞳の豊かな体つきで描いてください。
A single girl with short blonde hair and yellow eyes looks at the viewer, wings behind her among the clouds. She wears a white dress with a vest worn open, a bow and bowtie at her collar.
四人のケモノの男の子を。狼の少年たちが、ぬいぐるみを手に怒りマークを浮かべて苛立っています。隅に作者名と twitter のIDを添えて描いてください。
A single girl with brown hair and red eyes in a white kimono with wide sleeves, hugging a character doll. A futon and some unworn clothes beside her — an alternate costume.
A single boy with hair in brown and white, animal ears and an ahoge, looks at the viewer. He wears a white shirt under a jacket with a hat, eyes brown and purple, bangs between them.

Two girls outdoors under the clouds, one in twintails, the other in a braid. They wear dresses with thighhighs and gloves, hats and a necktie, ribbons and a clip in their hair, bangs between their eyes.
二人の女の子のコマ漫画。青髪やピンク、紫の髪をツインテールにし、青や紫、ピンクの瞳。白いドレスにベルト。英字のテキストを添えて描いてください。
赤い髪のショートヘアの美少年を一人で、上半身で。片目を前髪で隠し、丸眼鏡をかけ、黒いシャツに黒いチョーカー。口を閉じたバーチャルYouTuber風の姿で描いてください。
No humans — a horned, bug-like Pokémon with red eyes sits with its arms up, sparkles around it. Shown with others in its evolutionary line against a white background; a twitter handle in the corner.
緑の長髪に切りそろえた前髪の女の子を、手のひらサイズのミニキャラで。灰色の瞳に片目の眼帯、指でVサイン、:< の口元。周りに他の小さなキャラを添え、ほっぺのマークで描いてください。
黒髪のショートヘアの女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。紫の瞳に、肩を出した幅広の袖の着物に黒い手袋、帽子。髪に花を添えた姿で描いてください。
A single girl with hair in brown and black and red eyes looks at the viewer, bare-shouldered. She wears gloves and a skirt, navel and collarbone showing, a heart beside her, a fuller figure.
金髪や白髪の女の子と男の子たちを。アホ毛を立て、白いシャツにジャケットとネクタイ、黒い手袋。髪に花を添え、黄色い瞳の面々で描いてください。
青髪や赤髪の女の子と男の子たちを。白いシャツにジャケットの制服を前を開けて羽織り、ネクタイ。武器を手にした面々を、サイドの髪を垂らして描いてください。
黒い長髪に赤い瞳の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。制服に髪飾りと花、長袖。剣を手に血をにじませた緊迫した場面で描いてください。

A single girl with short pink hair and pink eyes grins widely. She wears a mob cap with a blue ribbon and a frilled collar, a veil and a little hitodama spirit beside her, blue eyes among the colours.
Two girls together, one with blonde hair, the other black-haired, blue eyes bright. They wear white short-sleeved shirts, ornaments in their hair, earrings glinting, a touch of jewelry.
茶色のショートヘアに茶色の瞳の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。白い襟付きシャツに黒いチョーカー、短いポニーテール。腕を下ろし、頬を赤らめた姿で描いてください。

Two girls together indoors, one blonde, the other black-haired, animal ears and yellow eyes. They wear dresses under jackets worn open, a touch of jewelry, an ahoge sticking up, bangs between their eyes.
A single girl with black hair in a school uniform looks at the viewer. She wears a white shirt with black gloves, a skirt and pantyhose, earrings glinting, bangs between her eyes, a fuller figure.
Three girls outdoors in kimono with wide sleeves, one with red hair, looking at the viewer. They wear floral-print kimono with sashes and obi — alternate costumes, a watermark in the corner.
Two girls in school uniforms, one with blue hair in twintails, the other red-haired, blushing. One has her mouth open, the other her eyes closed, a hair ribbon tucked in.
A single girl with long hair and pink eyes looks at the viewer. She wears a jacket worn open with a miniskirt, socks and kneehighs, sleeves covering her hands, food and fruit beside her.
長い髪を横で三つ編みにした女の子を一人で。ふくらんだ半袖の装いにベスト、本を手にしています。本棚ときのこを背に、口を開けた姿で描いてください。
二人の女の子を。金髪や茶髪、青髪の長い髪に、茶や青、紫の瞳。長袖のドレスに帽子とリボン、蝶結び。華やかな姿で描いてください。
茶色の長髪を低めのポニーテールにした女の子をちびキャラで。縞模様を取り入れた着物に帯を締め、リボンを添えています。口元は :3、茶色の背景で描いてください。
A single boy with purple eyes looks at the viewer indoors, a hat on his head. He wears a white coat with fur trim, a veil and rope nearby, his pupils bright, sharp-eyed; the artist signed it.
ピンクの長髪をツインテールにした女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。アホ毛と髪リボン、フリルのドレスに離れた袖、花。食べ物を添えた姿で描いてください。
紫の髪のショートヘアの女の子を一人で。眼鏡をかけ、黄色いスカート。テーブルと椅子のそばに立ち、ストロー付きの飲み物とパンを前にした場面で描いてください。
A single girl with long brown hair and brown eyes eats some food, bare-shouldered. She wears an orange shirt with a shoulder cutout, a date in the corner.
人のいない室内を、夜に。窓辺にシンクと椅子、カップが置かれた静かな台所の一角を描いてください。
A single girl with brown hair, animal ears and a tail, an ahoge and brown eyes, looks at the viewer. She wears a dress with a hair bow, pantyhose and shoes, bangs between her eyes, a fuller figure.
黒髪をお団子にまとめた女の子を、複数の角度から。切りそろえた前髪に髪リボン、幅広の袖のチャイナ風の装い。横顔で頬に手を当てた姿も添えて描いてください。

Two girls in school uniforms, one blonde with an ahoge, the other brown-haired. They wear sleeveless tops with thighhighs and gloves, neckties and a hairband, a hair ribbon and weapon among them, eyes yellow and brown.
A greyscale portrait of a single girl with asymmetrical short hair, a single sidelock and an X-shaped clip, pointing. Her expression is blank, mouth closed, against a plain background.
二人の姉妹と男の子のモノクロのコマ漫画。髪を左右で結い、タートルネックをまとっています。褐色肌の面々で、汗を一滴垂らした場面で描いてください。
Several girls together, hair in blonde, brown, black and red, one in twintails, another in a braid, one with a hood. Eyes brown and purple, food beside them, looking at the viewer.
ポインテッドイヤーの女の子を一人で、白黒で。中くらいの髪に眉をひそめ、ガムを噛みながら震え、涙を浮かべて前を見つめています。汗を添えた豊かな体つきで描いてください。
Two girls and a boy together, one girl with brown hair, the other blue-haired, bangs between their eyes. They wear white shirts under jackets, ornaments in their hair, eyes brown and blue.
A single boy with short brown hair and black eyes holds a sword. He wears a black shirt under a white jacket with black pants, a scar on his skin, bangs framing his face.
A single girl with grey hair holds a sword, small wings behind her. She wears a vest with a short-sleeved top and a hairband, armour and frills, a bow and bowtie, eyes green and yellow.
灰色の混ざった長い髪の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。角と尖った耳、肩を出した装いにネックレス。メイクを施した別衣装姿で、前髪を垂らして描いてください。

Two girls and a boy together, one girl blonde, the other pink-haired, animal ears poking up. They wear white shirts with a hat and necktie, a sailor collar and hairband, bangs between their eyes, blue eyes bright.
A single girl with very long grey hair, an ahoge and blue eyes in an alternate costume. She wears a short-sleeved dress with frills, a necktie, pantyhose and shoes, sidelocks framing her face.
金髪の男の子を一人で。褐色肌に青い瞳、袖なしの装いに髪リボンとイヤリング。眉をひそめた姿で描いてください。
茶色と青の混ざった長髪の、手のひらサイズのちびキャラの女の子。ティーカップの中にすっぽり入って両手を上げ、点のような目で。青い背景に影を落として描いてください。
Five girls together indoors, hair in blonde, brown, black, white and pink, one in twintails. They wear school uniforms with blue skirts, one holding a mirror.
茶色のショートヘアの女の子を一人で全身で。白いシャツの袖をまくり、青いパンツと靴。前髪を垂らし、舌をのぞかせて座った姿で、傍らにモンスターを添えて描いてください。

A single girl with white hair in a ponytail looks at the viewer against a black background, fire and goggles beside her. She wears black gloves, holding a sword, bangs between her eyes, bare-shouldered.
茶色のとても長い髪に切りそろえた前髪の女の子を一人で、ベッドの上で。長袖のフリルの装いに白いリボン、白いソックス。枕を添えた別衣装姿を、枠で囲んで描いてください。
黒髪のショートヘアに猫耳の猫娘を一人で、白黒で、白い背景に。アホ毛を立て、肩掛けの羽織りをまとい、波打つ口元。イヤリングを着け、影を添えて描いてください。
A single girl with long blonde and white hair, an ahoge and red eyes holds a weapon. She wears a dress with frills and a hair ribbon, a flower and ornament in her hair, a hairband holding it.
つばの広い帽子をかぶった人物を一人で全身で、白い背景に。毛皮で縁取られたマントを羽織り、マスクで顔を覆い、紙を手にしています。傍らにもう一人を添えて描いてください。
女の子と男の子を。女の子は黒や紫の髪を三つ編みにし、サイドの髪。赤いチャイナ風のシャツにエプロンとメイドのヘッドドレス、パンツ。ハートを添えた場面で描いてください。

A single girl with pink hair in a ponytail, an ahoge and yellow eyes in a school uniform, holding a weapon. She wears a white shirt with a necktie, bangs between her eyes, blue eyes among the colours.

Two girls together, one with black hair, the other pink-haired in a ponytail, animal ears poking up. They wear white shirts under jackets worn open with skirts, ahoge and sidelocks, an ornament in their hair.
白とピンクのグラデーションのショートヘアの女の子を上半身で。ピンクの瞳に、赤い襟付きシャツの長袖。別衣装姿で、口を閉じた姿で描いてください。
A single girl with red hair, an ahoge and sidelocks looks at the viewer. She wears a white collared shirt with a pleated skirt and a bow, a heart and food beside her, bangs between her eyes.
A single girl with short brown hair and yellow eyes grins widely. She wears a jacket with thighhighs, shorts and a hat with a bow and bowtie, shoes beneath — an official alternate costume.
二人の男の子を、白黒で。片方がもう片方の膝に座っています。逆立った髪にTシャツとパンツ、そばかす。仲睦まじい場面で描いてください。

Two girls together indoors, one with brown hair, the other black-haired. They wear jackets worn open with off-shoulder tops and fingerless gloves, a hood on one, earrings glinting, looking at the viewer.
A single girl with long white hair and purple eyes looks at the viewer in a long-sleeved dress, an ornament in her hair. English text beside her.
白い長髪に赤い瞳の女の子を一人で。幅広の袖の着物に帯を締め、手の先まで余る袖。赤いリボンとサイドの髪、サンダル。すらりとした姿で描いてください。
二人の男の子を。青髪や白髪に、背には翼。本を手にし、傍らに木と本棚、りんごなどの果物。開いた本を前にした穏やかな場面で描いてください。

A comic of several boys, one in glasses, another in sunglasses, leaning into a hug by a chair and table. Flying sweatdrops, motion lines, a shaded face and a clenched hand, speech bubbles between them.

Two girls with very long purple hair, one in two side-up tails, look at the viewer with :d grins. They wear dresses with hair bows, a heart and aqua eyes; a signature and twitter handle in the corner.
A single girl with very long hair in twintails and aqua eyes glances to the side. She wears a sleeveless top with a necktie and a black pleated skirt, bare-shouldered, a tattoo on her skin.
A single boy with grey streaked hair, small horns and pointed ears looks at the viewer. He wears a jacket with a bracelet and earrings, pink eyes bright, bangs between his eyes.
紫の髪のショートヘアに獣耳の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。紫の瞳に尖った耳、白いシャツにブーツ。剣を構えた別衣装姿のバーチャルYouTuber風で描いてください。
A two-panel meme comic of a girl with long brown hair, an ahoge and yellow eyes, shown in multiple views. She wears a sweater over a black bra, a :3 mouth and a heart beside her.
Two girls together, one blonde, the other with a braid, eyes red and purple. They wear white shirts with frilled skirts and hats with bows, boots beneath, a heart and hair bow tucked in.
二人の女の子を。金髪や青髪、白髪の長い髪に、青い瞳。肩を出した長袖のドレスに帽子、サイドの髪。髪に花を添えた華やかな姿で描いてください。
A single girl with very long blonde hair in twintails and an ahoge looks at the viewer. She wears a blue skirt with a blue bow and bowtie, socks and kneehighs, shoes beneath.

Two girls together, one blonde with very long hair, the other black-haired in twintails, blue eyes among the colours. They wear jackets with hats, ornaments and a touch of jewelry, brown eyes warm, looking at the viewer.
